programs.name: π：355/113 十进制长除法
programs.description: CPU 从 355 和 113 求出整数商、余数，再运行十进制长除法；π≈355/113，前 6 位小数正确，第 7 位起不同。
programs.source:
; Compute 355 / 113 using byte-wide repeated subtraction, then generate six
; decimal places by long division. 355 starts as high=1, low=99; neither the
; quotient nor the first remainder (16) is preloaded as a result.
        LDI 113
        ST D
        LDI 1
        ST HI
        LDI 99
        ST LO
        LDI 0
        ST Q

integer_loop:
        LD HI
        JZ integer_low
        LD LO
        SUB D
        ST LO
        JNC integer_borrow
        JMP integer_quotient
integer_borrow:
        LD HI
        ADDI -1
        ST HI
integer_quotient:
        LD Q
        ADDI 1
        ST Q
        JMP integer_loop

integer_low:
        LD LO
        SUB D
        JC integer_subtract
        ADD D
        ST LO
        JMP integer_ready
integer_subtract:
        ST LO
        LD Q
        ADDI 1
        ST Q
        JMP integer_loop

integer_ready:
        LD Q
        ADDI '0'
        OUT
        LDI '.'
        OUT
        LD LO
        ST R
        LDI 6
        ST COUNT

digit:
        LDI 0
        ST RUN
        ST DIGIT
        LDI 10
        ST ITER
step:
        LD RUN
        ADD R
        ST RUN
        SUB D
        JC subtract_divisor
        ADD D
        ST RUN
        JMP next_step
subtract_divisor:
        ST RUN
        LD DIGIT
        ADDI 1
        ST DIGIT
next_step:
        LD ITER
        ADDI -1
        ST ITER
        JZ step_done
        JMP step
step_done:
        LD RUN
        ST R
        LD DIGIT
        ADDI '0'
        OUT
        LD COUNT
        ADDI -1
        ST COUNT
        JZ finished
        JMP digit
finished:
        LDI '\n'
        OUT
        HALT

.equ D, 0
.equ R, 1
.equ RUN, 2
.equ DIGIT, 3
.equ COUNT, 4
.equ ITER, 5
.equ HI, 6
.equ LO, 7
.equ Q, 8

; CPU-generated π using the Rabinowitz–Wagon integer spigot.
; Emits 3 plus 64 fractional digits and a newline.
; For each output pass, i descends: x=10*a[i-1]+q*i; a[i-1]=x%(2*i-1); q=x//(2*i-1).
; The CPU implements the product and quotient with bounded 8/16-bit add/subtract loops.
; a[i] starts at 2; no π digit is stored in ROM or initial RAM.
; N=216; two bytes per array element across RAM banks 1..3.

.equ J, 0x21

.equ DH, 0x2D
.equ CL, 0x2E
.equ QT, 0x2F
.equ DIGIT, 0x30
.equ PTR, 0x31
.equ ZERO, 0x32

        LDI 0
        ST Q
        ST NINES
        ST PRED
        ST ZERO
        ST J
        ADDI 1
        ST J
outer:
        LDI 0
        ST Q
        LDI 216
        ST I
        LDI 0
        ST IH
        BANK 2
        LDI 174
        TAX
        JMP inner2
inner2:
        BANK 2
        LDAX
        BANK 0
        ST AL
        BANK 2
        INX
        LDAX
        BANK 0
        ST AH
        TXA
        ADDI -1
        ST PTR
        CALL process_cell
        BANK 0
        LD PTR
        TAX
        LD XL
        BANK 2
        STAX
        INX
        BANK 0
        LD XH
        BANK 2
        STAX
        DEX
        DEX
        DEX
        BANK 0
        LD I
        ADDI -1
        ST I
        JC index_no_borrow2
        LD IH
        ADDI -1
        ST IH
index_no_borrow2:
        LD I
        ADDI -128
        JZ switch_to_bank1
        JMP inner2
switch_to_bank1:
        BANK 1
        LDI 254
        TAX
        JMP inner1
inner1:
        BANK 1
        LDAX
        BANK 0
        ST AL
        BANK 1
        INX
        LDAX
        BANK 0
        ST AH
        TXA
        ADDI -1
        ST PTR
        CALL process_cell
        BANK 0

        LD XL
        BANK 1

        INX
        BANK 0

        BANK 1

        DEX

inner_done:
        BANK 0
        LD Q
        ST QT
        LDI 0
        ST DIGIT
divide_q_by_ten:
        LD QT
        ADDI -10
        JNC quotient_ready
        ST QT
        LD DIGIT
        ADDI 1
        ST DIGIT
        JMP9 divide_q_by_ten
quotient_ready:
        BANK 1
        LDI 0
        TAX
        BANK 0
        LD QT
        BANK 1

        INX
        BANK 0

        BANK 1

        LDI '.'

        LD Q
        ST PRED

        LD NINES
        JZ digit_complete
        LDI '9'

        LD IH

        LD XL

        LD CL
        ST XL
